content: Data Protection EF Core: package Microsoft.AspNetCore.DataProtection.EntityFrameworkCore (not in shared framework); context implements IDataProtectionKeyContext with DbSet<DataProtectionKey> DataProtectionKeys (Id int identity, FriendlyName, Xml nvarchar(max)); AddDataProtection().PersistKeysToDbContext<TContext>(). Explicit persistence disables default at-rest encryption; docs recommend explicit key encryption (X.509 / DPAPI) in production; SetApplicationName stable across deployments.
